_comment: Claude Code project settings template. Drop into .claude/settings.json in your repo. This file is tracked. Per-user overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).

permissions._comment: Permissions tighten or relax what Claude Code can do without prompting. See settings.local.json for the personal-override layer.

_env_comment: Environment variables passed to tools. Do NOT put secrets here - they belong in .env (gitignored) or in your shell profile.
_mcp_comment: The Claude Code CLI reads MCP servers from .mcp.json at the repo root (project scope) or ~/.claude.json (user scope). See runtimes/.claude/mcp.template.json for the template and runtimes/mcp/servers.yaml for the cross-vendor source of truth.
_hooks_comment: Hooks MUST live here, in settings.json. Claude Code does not read a project-level .claude/hooks/hooks.json - that filename is a hook source for plugins only. The "hooks" key below is already wired to the starter scripts in .claude/hooks/scripts/ and works as soon as you rename this file into place. To keep editing the annotated original at .claude/hooks/hooks.template.json instead, copy tools/sync-hooks-to-settings.sh out of the SpecRoute repo and re-run it after each edit; it merges hooks.json's .hooks key back into this file.
